title: health check endpoint returns server status
description: Verify that the GET /health endpoint returns the server status with a timestamp and version information, ensuring the server is operational.

title: user registration with email and turnstile verification
description: Test the POST /api/v1/auth/register endpoint to register a new user with email, password, name, birth year, occupation, life background, and turnstile token, and verify that a verification email is sent. Also test duplicate email registration returns 409.

title: email verification with 6 digit code and auto login
description: Test the POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email endpoint to verify the email using a 6-digit code and confirm that it returns access_token, refresh_token, and user_id for auto-login.

title: user login with email and password returns jwt tokens
description: Test the POST /api/v1/auth/login endpoint with valid and invalid credentials to verify successful login returns access_token, refresh_token, and user_id, and invalid credentials return 401.

title: refresh jwt tokens using refresh token
description: Test the POST /api/v1/auth/refresh endpoint to refresh JWT tokens by providing a valid refresh_token and verify that new access and refresh tokens are returned.

title: get current authenticated user profile
description: Test the GET /api/v1/auth/me endpoint with a valid bearer token to retrieve the current authenticated user's profile information, and verify unauthorized access is rejected.

title: logout invalidates token via blacklist
description: Test the POST /api/v1/auth/logout endpoint to logout the user by invalidating the current token via blacklist and verify the response confirms logout.

title: generate ai scenario with rate limiting and master account exemption
description: Test the POST /api/v1/scenarios/generate endpoint to generate AI-driven life scenarios with required parameters and verify that daily rate limiting is enforced for normal users and exempted for master accounts.

title: list user scenarios with pagination
description: Test the GET /api/v1/scenarios endpoint to retrieve a paginated list of scenarios owned by the authenticated user, verifying correct pagination and authentication enforcement.

title: delete scenario owned by user
description: Test the DELETE /api/v1/scenarios/{scenario_id} endpoint to delete a scenario owned by the authenticated user and verify that the scenario is removed and unauthorized deletion attempts are rejected.
